standard_prerequisites: ideals of definition of a Noetherian adic ring are pairwise commensurable: for any two ideals of definition I and I' there is c >= 0 with I^c subset I' and (I')^c subset I
the definition of rig-smooth homomorphisms of WAdm^Noeth via the completed naive cotangent complex (definition-rig-smooth-homomorphism)
the completed naive cotangent complex NL^wedge_{B/A} is independent of the chosen ideal of definition of A (remark-NL-well-defined-topological of the same chapter)
core_obligations: For a finite-type morphism A to B in WAdm^Noeth, condition (a) - B rig-smooth over (A, I) for SOME ideal of definition I - is equivalent to condition (b) - rig-smooth over (A, I') for ALL ideals of definition I'.

The proof fixes two ideals of definition I, I', uses commensurability I^c subset I' and (I')^c subset I, the rig-smooth definition, and the independence of NL^wedge_{B/A} from the ideal of definition to conclude the equivalence.
proof_roadmap: Take two ideals of definition I and I' of A and observe the commensurability inclusions I^c subset I' and (I')^c subset I.
Conclude rig-smoothness over (A, I) is equivalent to rig-smoothness over (A, I') from the rig-smooth definition, the inclusions, and the well-definedness of NL^wedge_{B/A}.
difficulty_reason: H2: a well-definedness argument that combines commensurability of ideals of definition with the invariance of the completed naive cotangent complex.
